title: Did the FASB Codification Reduce the Complexity of Applying U.S. GAAP?

scopes.description: The supplied SAS preparation workflow, including separate Compustat and Audit Analytics branches, the author-prepared crosswalks and manual input maps, the embedded Stata Table 4 restatement and Table 6 comment analyses, and the descriptive XML output stage.

requirements.description: Author-prepared SIC4-to-SEC-office mapping (`SEC_Office.xlsx`) imported as `g.sec_office`; source uses SIC4, SEC_OFFICE and Industry_Title for the 11-office expansion/joins. The workbook and its historical mapping construction are not in the supplied package.
Author-prepared Audit Analytics restatement-category to ASC-topic map (`Restate_Taxonomy_JAR.xlsx`), requiring Restatement___category_key and accounting_topic; used in the main restatement branch.
Author-prepared comment-conversation period map (`cl_timeperiod.xlsx`) with COMPANY_FKEY, CL_CON_ID, PF, CL_BDATE and CL_EDATE; code selects PF=1 for comment window construction.
Author-prepared topic-quarter input (`Restate_form.xlsx`) with ASC_TOPIC, BEG_DATE, END_DATE, YEAR and C_QTR. The supplied program expands each ASC topic across SEC_OFFICE values 1–11.

Author-prepared Codification CrossRef workbook with All and Home sheets: All provides TOPIC/SUBTOPIC/SECTION/PARAGRAPH/STANDARD_TYPE/STANDARD_NUMBER/Paragraph___Label/SEQUENCE; Home provides TOPIC_NUMBER/TOPIC_NAME. Author code notes the FASB data was accessed in December 2019.

routes.location: FASB Codification Basic View (public access described in the official FAQ)
routes.description: Public Basic View is a possible content route, but compatibility with the authors’ December 2019 workbook, exact All/Home sheet structure and field mapping is unverified.
routes.expected_period: Codification snapshot accessed in December 2019 according to author code; an equivalent public workbook/version is not established.

requirements.description: Compustat quarterly fundamentals through `compd.fundq`, filtered to domestic industrial consolidated standard-format observations, FYEARQ 2000–2016, and nonmissing DATACQTR and ATQ*SALEQ.

routes.description: Catalog lists the North America COMP.FUNDQ physical file (also aliased as COMPD.FUNDQ). A bounded one-row Python read found all listed program fields. Full historical period, version and licensed workflow access remain unverified.

requirements.description: Compustat company table `compd.company`, joined by GVKEY to obtain the current SIC used for SIC1/SIC2/SIC4 derivation and SEC-office assignment. The supplied source requires GVKEY and SIC only; it does not specify a dated SIC series.

routes.description: The catalogued COMP.COMPANY physical file was successfully read through a bounded Python row-one probe, which confirms GVKEY and SIC. The supplied source joins by GVKEY and uses SIC; no dated SIC series or historical byte identity is specified.

requirements.description: Audit Analytics audit-opinion table, filtered by FISCAL_YEAR_OF_OP 2002–2016; supplies company, auditor/state and fiscal-year end for the restatement and comment branches.

routes.description: FEED34 is a catalogued USA-oriented candidate and its one-row probe contains the five core join/derivation fields. The full author KEEP-list also names FISCAL_YE and LARGE_OFFICE, which were not in the candidate columns; neither later analysis use nor historical coverage is established.

requirements.description: Audit Analytics non-reliance restatements (`audit.auditnonreli`) with the 26 selected fields named in the source, including RES_NOTIF_KEY, RES_ACC_RES_FKEY_LIST and DISC_TEXT1; filter FILE_DATE 15706–20819.

routes.description: FEED39 is only a catalogued candidate: the bounded alias query found four of seven key fields checked and did not find RES_NOTIF_KEY, RES_ACC_RES_FKEY_LIST or DISC_TEXT1. The full 26-field source contract and period compatibility remain unverified.
routes.expected_period: SAS numeric FILE_DATE filter 15706–20819; author datasheet reports a February 2020 download as provenance.

requirements.description: Separate `common.auditcblock` input joined on COMPANY_FKEY to provide SIC_CODE_FKEY. The exact table has no bounded catalog record; SEDAR/Europe candidates do not establish a compatible US company-block route.
Audit Analytics comment-letter detail (`audit.commlett`) filtered to EVENT_DATE>MDY(09,1,2004), retaining the fields needed to map filings/conversations (16 source fields in the KEEP statement).

routes.description: FEED25 is a catalogued candidate. Five downstream join/filter fields are listed in the catalog, but the complete source KEEP-list and history remain unverified; the bounded one-row read timed out and no fallback was attempted.
routes.expected_period: EVENT_DATE greater than 2004-09-01; author datasheet reports January 2020 download as provenance.

requirements.description: Separate Audit Analytics comment-response thread table (`audit.commlettthreads`), filtered to 16437<=QUESTION_LETTER_DATE<=20088 and retaining question/answer text, dates and keys.

routes.description: FEED40 is a catalogued candidate; the bounded one-row probe confirms the 22 fields named in the source KEEP statement. Full period/history and compatible author vintage remain unverified.
routes.expected_period: QUESTION_LETTER_DATE SAS numeric filter 16437–20088; author datasheet reports January 2020 download as provenance.

requirements.description: Local `g.lm_complexity` table consumed by both restatement and comment analyses, keyed by CIK_CHAR/FYEAR and providing COMPLEXITY/MEDIAN_COMPLEXITY; the supplied program has no producer, import step or source-file contract.

issues.kind: missing author-prepared workbook inputs and construction contracts
issues.description: Five distinct author-side files named by the source are absent from the assigned package inventory: SEC_Office.xlsx, Restate_Taxonomy_JAR.xlsx, cl_timeperiod.xlsx, Restate_form.xlsx and Codification_CrossRef.xlsx. The code specifies key fields and transformations but not the workbook construction/history or an exact public delivery path. The supplied identifier workbook is not a substitute.

issues.kind: unresolved Audit Analytics restatement and company-block table contracts
issues.description: The source needs audit.auditnonreli and common.auditcblock as separate jointly required tables. The local FEED39 restatement candidate lacks three catalogued source fields, the exact company-block lookup returned no record, and only non-US company-block candidates were found; these findings do not prove no data or access.

issues.kind: missing producer and source contract for required complexity table
issues.description: The supplied program joins g.lm_complexity in both main branches but does not create/import it or identify its source. Its history, population, definitions and CIK/FYEAR formatting remain unresolved.

issues.kind: undefined remote, library and embedded-Stata configuration
issues.description: The source invokes %wrds, RSUBMIT/PROC DOWNLOAD and %stata_wrapper, reads/writes through g.* libraries, and contains Windows workstation input/output paths. The required macro definitions, remote session/data-transfer contract, libname g mapping, portable run root and Stata bridge are not supplied. The actual in-memory reg_sample is the analysis endpoint; the source does not require a new cleaned-data export.

The supplied program spells the PROC EXPAND option `menhod=none` on lines 562 and 581. Official SAS documentation supports `METHOD=NONE`; correcting these two tokens is a supported preparation edit and does not require scientific reconstruction.

actions.description: Identify or obtain the five exact author-prepared workbooks named in the supplied SAS source, and establish their field/type/history contracts. Treat each workbook as a separate jointly required input. The supplied identifier list does not replace any of them.
steps: Locate the author release for SEC_Office.xlsx, Restate_Taxonomy_JAR.xlsx, cl_timeperiod.xlsx, Restate_form.xlsx and Codification_CrossRef.xlsx; if the files are unavailable, request their construction details and permitted delivery route.
For SEC_Office, confirm SIC4, SEC_OFFICE and Industry_Title definitions and the office mapping period; for Restate_Taxonomy, confirm the Restatement___category_key to accounting_topic map.
For cl_timeperiod, confirm COMPANY_FKEY/CL_CON_ID joins, PF coding and CL_BDATE/CL_EDATE types; for Restate_form, confirm ASC_TOPIC, BEG_DATE, END_DATE, YEAR and C_QTR.

For Codification_CrossRef, confirm both All and Home sheets, the listed columns, numeric/text types, and compatibility with the December 2019 snapshot. The free Basic View check establishes content access only, not the exact workbook export.

Check required SEC Office IDs, taxonomy keys/topics, CL conversation keys/date/PF fields, Restate Form date/topic fields, and both CrossRef sheet schemas before any full run.

review_notes: The supplied package includes one SAS program, its datasheet, an identifier workbook and an online appendix. The datasheet describes the Excel workbook as identifiers for final-sample observations; the bounded XLSX probe reads one row, reports four first-sheet headers and explicitly marks coverage unverified. It is not a full analysis dataset or a route that replaces required source inputs.

Target scope is the supplied full SAS preparation workflow and its actual embedded Stata restatement, comment and descriptive-output branches. The online appendix provides additional robustness results but this package supplies no separate program branch for them; no paper-wide analyses were added. No related-package candidates were listed for this assigned item.

Each missing author workbook, Compustat table, Audit Analytics table and g.lm_complexity input is represented as a separate mandatory requirement. Any compatible prepared input would be an alternative route for that same input; it is not an extra raw-plus-prepared requirement. The current identifier list is not such a compatible prepared input.

Catalog records are metadata only and do not establish licensing, access or historical coverage. The frozen lookup helper failed because its sibling resources.py path was missing; the exact catalog fallback was bounded to selected records. An initial broad selected-record capture exceeded the 1 MiB limit and remains preserved; narrower per-table outputs were used. No matching hit or miss is treated as license or access proof.

The COMP.FUNDQ, COMP.COMPANY, FEED34 and FEED40 local metadata probes used Python row_limit=1 through separate guarded child processes. They establish a readable first row and the listed fields only, not full coverage, version or population. COMP.COMPANY is a verified route for the source’s current GVKEY-to-SIC lookup; the source does not require a dated SIC series. FEED34 and FEED40 retain their separate historical-period verification gaps, and the FEED25 timeout remains inconclusive.

The author datasheet records FASB Codification data downloaded in December 2019 and Audit Analytics restatement/comment-response downloads in February/January 2020. These dates are provenance, not independent proof of required product fields or a demand for byte-identical historic files.

An official FASB check confirms free Basic View content access without an account, but the check did not establish an equivalent December 2019 All/Home workbook export or its field mapping; that route remains unverified. The datasheet’s general public-availability statement also does not verify the exact Compustat/Audit Analytics input products.

The supplied `%WT` macro remains part of the author code and its output tables are covered as generated dependencies. A conservative source-reader window withheld lines 352–355 because they matched a broad credential/connection candidate pattern; the candidate scan is not confirmation of content and is not treated as a missing-macro, input or scientific blocker. No credentials or raw connection blocks are reproduced.

The saved environment artifact reports Stata 18, reghdfe 6.12.3 and ftools 2.49.1; outreg2 was not found in checked adopaths. SAS startup did not complete its bounded environment probe because TKELS initialization failed, which leaves SAS runtime availability unverified and does not establish a licensing barrier. No author code, estimators, SAS programs or data payloads were run during this assessment.

The two supplied PROC EXPAND lines contain the literal spelling menhod=none. The saved official SAS/ETS result confirms METHOD=NONE is supported and specifies no interpolation. The two exact source_edit proposals correct only that option spelling and remain unapplied; this is a preparation fix, separate from unresolved data and runtime dependencies.
